name: ai-employees
description: Hire any of eight open source AI Employees into a local folder: GTM Engineer, SEO/AEO, Web Dev, Social Media, Ad Manager, Sales, Customer Satisfaction and Chief of Staff. Each one is a folder of scheduled routines that covers a whole business role, drafts and stages the work, leaves the last click to you, and improves from your corrections. The hire skill copies the kit, runs its self tests and hands over the install prompt. It registers no schedule and sends nothing. MIT licensed.

interface.longDescription: Eight open source AI Employees, each a folder of scheduled routines that covers one business role: GTM Engineer, SEO/AEO, Web Dev, Social Media, Ad Manager, Sales, Customer Satisfaction and Chief of Staff. The hire skill copies the kit you pick into a folder you choose, runs its self tests and hands you the install prompt. The employee then sets itself up in that folder, schedules its own routines and leaves a short brief each weekday. It drafts and stages the work and leaves every send, post and payment to you. The hire skill registers no schedule, sends nothing and collects no data. Needs Node 18 or newer and a shell, so it runs in Codex, not in ChatGPT chat.
